indexPrompt.ens-two-teams-of-models: Team 1 trains small neural nets on the full training set, each from a different random seed, and averages their predictions. Averaging 5 nets gives a variance of 0.8 at one test input and averaging 15 gives 0.6. Assume every net's prediction has the same variance and every pair of nets the same correlation.
indexPrompt.ens-adaboost-after-one-round: Partway through AdaBoost, eight training rows carry weights that add up to 1. This round's stump misclassifies rows 4 and 6 and gets the other six right. AdaBoost gives it its vote and updates the weights as in the lesson.
indexPrompt.ens-patients-out-of-bag: A clinic's table has 300 patients with three visits each, one row per visit, 900 rows in all. A patient's three rows are nearly identical, and they carry the same label. A random forest of 200 deep trees is trained on the 900 rows with oob_score=True, and the model will be used on patients the clinic has not seen yet.
